sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: 光功率計：參考不確定度與最差裕度
related.titleEn: Optical power meter: reference uncertainty and worst-case margin
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學差值預期6±0.5 dB；3 dB不符，要求局部證據後再決定修復部位。 dual_lambda.csv、校正紀錄與事件差分圖 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 6 與變更 3 dB、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching expected difference6±0.5 dB;3 dB is inconsistent and requires local evidence before selecting a repair location. dual_lambda.csv, calibration record and event-difference plot Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 6 and changed 3 dB, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 只有最差裕度非負才做有界通過宣告；變更組屬證據不足，不能直接判定光纖損壞。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Declare bounded acceptance only when worst-case margin is nonnegative; the changed case is inconclusive, not proof of damaged fiber.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成40 km路徑：1310 nm係數0.35、1550 nm係數0.20 dB/km；變更1550 nm額外局部損耗3 dB。 名義式 40*0.35-40*0.2 = 6 dB；變更式 40*0.35-(40*0.2+3) = 3 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐波長獨立算總損耗再作差；以局部OTDR事件區分固定接頭與全段斜率。

合成可容許損耗10 dB，量測8.8 dB；發射與接收讀值界限各0.3 dB；變更界限各0.7 dB。 名義式 10-(8.8+0.3+0.3) = 0.6 dB；變更式 10-(8.8+0.7+0.7) = -0.2 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 枚舉兩個儀器誤差的四個角落；找出最大損耗，並保留校正日期與共同誤差來源。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic40 km route:0.35 dB/km at1310 nm and0.20 dB/km at1550 nm; add3 dB localized1550 nm loss in the changed case. Nominal 40*0.35-40*0.2 = 6 dB; changed 40*0.35-(40*0.2+3) = 3 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Calculate each wavelength total independently before subtraction; localize an OTDR event rather than attributing all differences to a uniform slope.

Synthetic loss allowance10 dB and measured loss8.8 dB; transmitter/receiver error bounds each0.3 dB, changed to0.7 dB. Nominal 10-(8.8+0.3+0.3) = 0.6 dB; changed 10-(8.8+0.7+0.7) = -0.2 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate four corners of the two instrument-error intervals, locate maximum loss, and retain calibration dates and common errors.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: G.709 OTN：框架有效負載利用率
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學差值預期6±0.5 dB；3 dB不符，要求局部證據後再決定修復部位。 dual_lambda.csv、校正紀錄與事件差分圖 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 6 與變更 3 dB、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching expected difference6±0.5 dB;3 dB is inconsistent and requires local evidence before selecting a repair location. dual_lambda.csv, calibration record and event-difference plot Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 6 and changed 3 dB, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學服務要求88 Gbit/s；9000-bit負載達標，8500不足；不得由框架效率推斷延遲。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching service requires88 Gbit/s:9000-bit payload passes and8500 fails; efficiency does not establish latency.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成40 km路徑：1310 nm係數0.35、1550 nm係數0.20 dB/km；變更1550 nm額外局部損耗3 dB。 名義式 40*0.35-40*0.2 = 6 dB；變更式 40*0.35-(40*0.2+3) = 3 dB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐波長獨立算總損耗再作差；以局部OTDR事件區分固定接頭與全段斜率。

合成每框10000 bits，其中負載9000；線速100 Gbit/s；變更負載8500而框長不變。 名義式 100*9000/10000 = 90 Gbit/s；變更式 100*8500/10000 = 85 Gbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以一秒完整框數乘每框負載獨立驗算；明示忽略最後不完整框的連續近似。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic40 km route:0.35 dB/km at1310 nm and0.20 dB/km at1550 nm; add3 dB localized1550 nm loss in the changed case. Nominal 40*0.35-40*0.2 = 6 dB; changed 40*0.35-(40*0.2+3) = 3 dB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Calculate each wavelength total independently before subtraction; localize an OTDR event rather than attributing all differences to a uniform slope.

Synthetic10000-bit frame with9000 payload bits at100 Gbit/s; change payload to8500 with total frame size fixed. Nominal 100*9000/10000 = 90 Gbit/s; changed 100*8500/10000 = 85 Gbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Cross-check frames per second multiplied by payload bits and state the continuous approximation for the final partial frame.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
